subject: How to assign aes to columns by number

messages.author: decd30055c435d87
messages.subject: How to assign aes to columns by number
parts:
Hello, I have a dataframe with 28 columns and I want to plot column 5
against column 8, column 11 against column 14, etc. The pattern is very
regular (n1 vs n1+3, n1+6 vs n1+6+3, etc.) so it would be very
convenient to specify the columns by number. However, I can't figure out
how to write the aes() using numeric indices. I tried
aes(x=names(dataframe)[n1], y=names(dataframe)[n1+3])
and
aes(x=dataframe[ ,n1], y=dataframe[ , n1+3])
but neither worked. (I didn't think they would.)

Can anyone help me with this?
Thanks in advance.
--
Stuart Luppescu <s...@ccsr.uchicago.edu>
University of Chicago

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: How to assign aes to columns by number
parts:
?aes_string()

paste() the column names. Works especially well if you're looping through an index.
